messages.text: I am having some issues with my Nexus S1 display

Hi, I'm Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist, and I'll help you sort out the display.

To start, what is the screen on your Nexus S1 doing right now?

1. Completely blank or black
2. Lit up but frozen, or stuck on the boot or logo screen
3. Showing garbled lines, wrong colours or flickering
4. Working, but the information on it looks wrong (for example the hashrate or IP)

A photo of the screen would help a lot. Can you also check whether the miner is still hashing? Its fans would be running, or you'd see it in your pool dashboard or the web UI if you know its IP.
Lank screen but it’s still hashing in the HashWatcher app
Searched the web · Nexus S1 miner display blank setting

Since it's still hashing, the miner itself is fine. That's good news.

The Nexus S1 runs firmware based on ESP-Miner (the Bitaxe firmware), and on that firmware the screen can be switched off in settings. A user on the Nexus firmware's GitHub has described [turning the display off on a Nexus S1](https://github.com/BitLuckFW/ESP-Miner-Nexus/issues/12). So let's first rule out a setting:

1. In HashWatcher, find your S1's IP address (for example 192.168.x.x).
2. Type that IP into a browser on the same network to open the miner's web dashboard.
3. Go to **Settings** and look for anything about the display or screen, like "display off", a screen timeout or flip/rotate. If there is one, make sure the display is on and save.

What does the settings page show? Please also tell me the firmware version, which appears in the dashboard, often at the bottom or under System. A screenshot is fine too.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

Thanks, I opened the photo. It's the update section of the miner's dashboard. Your S1 is on **nexus.v1.0.4.4**, and the dropdown shows v1.0.4.4 as the latest release (Sep 4, 2026, file esp-miner-factory-NexusS1-v1.0.4.4.bin). So your firmware is up to date and we can rule that out.

Next check:

1. In the dashboard, open the **Settings** page (not the Update page) and scroll through it. Is there an option for the display or screen, like display on/off, a screen timeout or rotate? If there is, tell me what it's set to.
2. If there's no display option, press the red **Restart** button at the top of the page. Watch the screen while the miner boots. Does it light up at all, even briefly?

Let me know what you see.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

I've looked at the photo. Under **Misc Settings**, **Flip Screen** and **Automatic Screen Shutdown** are both unchecked, and the shutdown temperature is set to 90. That means no setting is turning the screen off, so we can rule that out too.

Next step:

1. Scroll back to the top of the dashboard and press the red **Restart** button.
2. Watch the screen while it boots, for about a minute.

Does the screen light up at all, even for a moment, or does it stay completely black? If it stays black, try one more thing: unplug the power at the miner, wait 30 seconds, then plug it back in. Let me know what the screen does.
Ok give me a minute
No rush. Take your time and tell me what the screen does after the restart and, if needed, the unplug.
It flashed for a second and then went blank
Read github.com/BitLuckFW/ESP-Miner-Nexus/issues
Searched the web · ESP-Miner-Nexus S1 screen flashes then blank
Handed to the team · Checked so far: firmware is the latest (v1.0.4.4, Sep 4 2026). In Settings, Flip

Thanks, that tells us something useful. The quick flash means the screen is getting power and the miner reaches it at boot. Then something stops it from showing the normal screens. Your mining isn't affected: the hashing hardware is working fine and this only concerns the display.

You've already ruled out the usual causes: your firmware is the latest (v1.0.4.4), and both Flip Screen and Automatic Screen Shutdown are off. I couldn't find a documented fix for this on the Nexus firmware, so I've passed it to JD, our hardware lead, along with your screenshots and everything we tried. Someone will pick up your ticket and get back to you by email with an answer.

The faster route is our Discord: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf. Mention **@nullhashrate** (that's JD). He and the community are very active there.

One small thing you can try meanwhile, if you haven't yet: unplug the power at the miner for a full 30 seconds, then plug it back in. A web UI restart doesn't always fully reset the screen. If the screen comes back, let me know here or on Discord.
Ok will try that

Sounds good. After the 30-second unplug, there are two possible outcomes:

1. **The screen comes back:** you're all set. Just let me know so the team can close it out.
2. **It still flashes and goes blank:** a short phone video of the boot would help JD a lot. Start it from plugging in until the screen goes dark, and send it here or post it on Discord with @nullhashrate.

Either way, your miner keeps hashing normally in the meantime.
Sure but it’s brand new and should not have this issue

You're right, and I understand the frustration. A brand-new miner should have a working screen out of the box.

The results of the unplug test and the boot video tell JD what's actually causing it. It could be something on the firmware side, or it could be the screen itself or its connection. That decides the right fix for your unit. Your case is already flagged with everything we've checked so far, so you won't need to start over.

If the unplug doesn't bring the screen back, send the video here. I'll add it to the case straight away.
